**Finding: compliant (no redline proposed).**

The Agreement contains no audit, inspection, verification or records-examination right binding Mortgage Logic.com as Client. The only verification-type mechanic (§ 6, p0047) runs in our favour — TrueLink must provide documentation supporting charges and we may contest them. § 8's Client covenants create no inspection right, and the access provisions (p0037, p0060) either benefit us or relate to TrueLink's own remediation obligations. Since there is no Vendor audit right at all, we are better off than the preferred position on every parameter (frequency, notice, cost allocation, system access), so no redline is warranted. If TrueLink raises an audit right in negotiation, we would insist on the preferred parameters.
